arxiv-1802-07366.title: Free Complete Wasserstein Algebras
arxiv-1802-07366.creator: Radu Mardare, Prakash Panangaden, Gordon D. Plotkin
arxiv-1802-07366.description: Abstract . We present an algebraic account of the Wasserstein distances W p W_{p} on complete metric spaces, for p ≥ 1 p\geq 1 . This is part of a program of a quantitative algebraic theory of effects in programming languages.

arxiv-2106-08536.title: Detection of Consonant Errors in Disordered Speech Based on Consonant-Vowel Segment Embedding
arxiv-2106-08536.creator: Si-Ioi Ng, Cymie Wing-Yee Ng, Jingyu Li, Tan Lee
arxiv-2106-08536.description: Abstract Speech sound disorder (SSD) refers to a type of developmental disorder in young children who encounter persistent difficulties in producing certain speech sounds at the expected age. Consonant errors are the major indicator of SSD in clinical assessment. Previous studies on automatic assessment of SSD revealed that detection of speech errors concerning short and transitory consonants is less satisfactory.

arxiv-2301-11852.title: A Sequential Global Programming Approach for Two-scale Optimization of Homogenized Multiphysics Problems with Application to Biot Porous Media
arxiv-2301-11852.creator: Bich Ngoc Vu, Vladimir Lukeš, Michael Stingl, Eduard Rohan
arxiv-2301-11852.description: Abstract We present a new approach and an algorithm for optimizing the material configuration and behaviour of a fluid saturated porous medium in a two-scale setting. The state problem is governed by the Biot model describing the fluid-structure interaction in homogenized poroelastic structures.

arxiv-2302-09119.title: A Review on Generative Adversarial Networks for Data Augmentation in Person Re-Identification Systems
arxiv-2302-09119.creator: Víctor Uc-Cetina, Laura Álvarez-González, Anabel Martin-Gonzalez
arxiv-2302-09119.description: Abstract Interest in automatic people re-identification systems has significantly grown in recent years, mainly for developing surveillance and smart shops software. Due to the variability in person posture, different lighting conditions, and occluded scenarios, together with the poor quality of the images obtained by different cameras, it is currently an unsolved problem.

arxiv-2309-10943.title: Recent advances in algorithmic problems for semigroups
arxiv-2309-10943.creator: Ruiwen Dong
arxiv-2309-10943.description: Abstract In this article we survey recent progress in the algorithmic theory of matrix semigroups. The main objective in this area of study is to construct algorithms that decide various properties of finitely generated subsemigroups of an infinite group G G , often represented as a matrix group. Such problems might not be decidable in general.

arxiv-2410-10209.title: EffiCoder : Enhancing Code Generation in Large Language Models through Efficiency-Aware Fine-tuning
arxiv-2410-10209.creator: Dong Huang, Guangtao Zeng, Jianbo Dai, Meng Luo, Han Weng, Yuhao Qing, Heming Cui, Zhijiang Guo, Jie M. Zhang
arxiv-2410-10209.description: Abstract As Large Language Models (LLMs) play an important role in code generation, enhancing both correctness and efficiency has become crucial. Current methods primarily focus on correctness, often overlooking efficiency. To address this gap, we introduce EffiCoder to improve both aspects by fine-tuning LLMs on a high-quality dataset EffiInstruct comprising correct and efficient code samples.

arxiv-2412-18737.title: The moments of the spectral form factor in SYK
arxiv-2412-18737.creator: Andrea Legramandi
arxiv-2412-18737.description: Abstract In chaotic quantum systems the spectral form factor exhibits a universal linear ramp and plateau structure with superimposed erratic oscillations. The mean signal and the statistics of the noise can be probed by the moments of the spectral form factor, also known as higher-point spectral form factors.

arxiv-2501-18660.title: NAR db status Version 2 and miRNAverse: Over Two Years of Manual Meta-Registry Curation and Updates
arxiv-2501-18660.creator: Marcel Friedrichs, Cassandra Königs
arxiv-2501-18660.description: Abstract Previously, we reported on a new meta-registry for NAR published databases focusing on high-quality annotations regarding database availability and longevity. With over two years of continued manual curation, here, we report on recent updates and additions. Furthermore, the available annotations as well as the underlying database structure have been unified with the miRNAverse meta-registry.

arxiv-2505-04481.title: CAD-Llama: Leveraging Large Language Models for Computer-Aided Design Parametric 3D Model Generation
arxiv-2505-04481.creator: Jiahao Li, Weijian Ma, Xueyang Li, Yunzhong Lou, Guichun Zhou, Xiangdong Zhou, {yzlou20, gczhou19, xdzhou}@fudan.edu.cn
arxiv-2505-04481.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jiahao Li, Weijian Ma, Xueyang Li, Yunzhong Lou, Guichun Zhou, Xiangdong Zhou, {yzlou20, gczhou19, xdzhou}@fudan.edu.cn. Recently, Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved significant success, prompting increased interest in expanding their generative capabilities beyond general text into domain-specific areas. This study investigates the generation of parametric sequences for computer-aided design (CAD) models using LLMs. This endeavor represents an initial step towards creating parametric 3D shapes with LLMs, as CAD model parameters directly correlate with shapes in three-dimensional space.

arxiv-2510-25903.title: Selective Parametric Amplification of Degenerate Modes in Electrostatically Transduced Coupled Beam Resonators
arxiv-2510-25903.creator: Vishnu Kumar, Nishta Arora, Bhargavi B.A, Akshay Naik, Saurabh A. Chandorkar
arxiv-2510-25903.description: Abstract Parametric excitation in coupled mechanical systems has enabled advances in sensing, computation, and phonon control. The function of distinct phase modes using parametric driving remains insufficiently explored. Here, we investigate the nonlinear and parametric response of degenerate phase modes in a Double Ended Tuning Fork (DETF) resonator.

pmc-11448286.title: Expiratory flow limitation development index (ELDI): a novel method of assessing respiratory mechanics in COPD
pmc-11448286.creator: James Dean, Stephen J Fowler, Dave Singh, Augusta Beech
pmc-11448286.description: BackgroundExpiratory flow limitation (EFL) can be detected using oscillometric reactance and is associated with a worse clinical presentation in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). Reactance can show negative swings upon exhalation, which may develop at different rates between patients. We propose a new method to quantify the rate of EFL development; the EFL Development Index (ELDI).

pmc-11496999.title: An Interactive Vision‐Based 3D Augmented Reality System for In‐Home Physical Rehabilitation: A Qualitative Inquiry to Inform System Development
pmc-11496999.creator: Afolasade Fakolade, Adriana C Salvia, Siona Phadke, Manuela Kunz
pmc-11496999.description: BackgroundPostoperative physical rehabilitation is crucial after total joint replacement (TJR). However, completing the recommended levels of postoperative physical exercise is challenging for many older adults with TJR. Lack of adequate postoperative physical exercise has negative consequences on rehabilitation outcomes. Innovative rehabilitation tools for postoperative physical exercises are needed to ensure successful rehabilitation outcomes among older adults with TJR.

pmc-11637981.title: Recurrent evolution of small body size and loss of the sword ornament in Northern swordtail fish
pmc-11637981.creator: Gabriel A Preising, Theresa Gunn, John J Baczenas, Daniel L Powell, Tristram O Dodge, Sean T Sewell, Alexa Pollock, Jose Angel Machin Kairuz, Markita Savage, Yuan Lu, Meredith Fitschen-Brown, Axel Meyer, Manfred Schartl, Molly Cummings, Sunishka Thakur, Callen M Inman, Oscar Ríos-Cardenas, Molly Mor
pmc-11637981.description: Across the tree of life, species have repeatedly evolved similar phenotypes. While well-studied for ecological traits, there is also evidence for recurrent evolution of sexually selected traits. Swordtail fish (Xiphophorus) is a classic model system for studying sexual selection, and female Xiphophorus exhibit strong mate preferences for large male body sizes and a range of sexually dimorphic ornaments.

pmc-11690713.title: QUANTIFYING PACE OF AGING AMONG OLDER ADULTS: AN ANALYSIS WITH HEALTH AND RETIREMENT STUDY
pmc-11690713.creator: Arun Balachandran, Heming Pei, Meeraj Kothari, Benjamin Dominigue, Alex Furuya, Dan Belsky
pmc-11690713.description: Rise in global population aging and age-related morbidities calls for measures that that can detect differences in aging trajectories in time to reduce and prevent disease burdens. Pace of Aging (PoA) measure captures longitudinal change in human physiology across multiple systems and captures within-individual changes.

pmc-12285370.title: 간경변증 환자에서 발생한 급성 신손상에 대한 치료 알고리즘
pmc-12285370.creator: Myeong Jun Song
pmc-12285370.description: 검증하고, 신기능의 결과와 환자 생존율을 평가하는 것을 목표로 하였다.2 본 연구는 2019년 6월부터 2021년 6월까지 바르셀로나 병원에 입원한 간경변증 환자 중 AKI가 진단된 139명을 대상으로 한 전향적 코호트 연구이다. 연구에서는 EASL AKI 관리 알고리즘에 따라 치료가 적용되었으며, 초기 AKI 진단 후 2일간 알부민 정주가 시행되었다. 주요 평가 지표는 치료 반응(완전 반응과 부분 반응 포함)이며, 2차 평가 지표는 90일 생존율이다.

pmc-12327122.title: The utility of Insulin Like Growth Factor Binding Proteins (IGFBPs-1, 2, 3) with genes expression in resistance to Imatinib and Nilotinib in chronic myeloid leukemia: a pilot study from Delta Egypt
pmc-12327122.creator: Nadia El Menshawy, Mohamed Sabry El-Ghonemy, Shaimaa El-Ashwah, Heidi Elkerdawy, Ramy Abbas, Mostafa Abdelhakiem, Maha Saif, Ahmed EL-Sebaie
pmc-12327122.description: IntroductionResistance to tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKIs) is an obstacle facing CML patients in spite of the high cure rate. In this context, a study association between IGFBP (1, 2, 3) genes expression and their proteins in CML with the response to TKI has been implicated.

pmc-12485219.title: Outcome of Percutaneous Coronary Intervention for Left Versus Non-left Main Coronary Artery in Acute Coronary Syndrome: A Comparative Study
pmc-12485219.creator: S M Mamun Iqbal, A M Shafique, Neuton Mondal, Mohammad Jahid Hasan
pmc-12485219.description: Background and objective: Acute coronary syndromes (ACS), particularly those affecting the left main coronary artery (LMCA), are associated with high morbidity and mortality. The objective of the present study was to investigate long-term outcomes in patients who underwent percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) for ACS affecting the LMCA compared to those with non-LMCA involvement.

pmc-12604320.title: Risk of prostate cancer associated with long-term air pollution exposure: a nationwide cohort study in Taiwan
pmc-12604320.creator: Yu-Ming Shen, Shu-Han Chuang, Cheng-Hsien Chang, Yi-Jie Kuo, Shun-Jen Cheng, Han-Wei Zhang, Yu-Shan Ling, Pao-Hwa Chen, Yu-Pin Chen
pmc-12604320.description: Background and objectiveProstate cancer is a critical health issue, particularly in developed countries. Emerging evidence suggests that air pollution is associated with increased risk of prostate cancer. This study aimed to evaluate the impact of long-term exposure to seven specific air pollutants on prostate cancer risk in Taiwanese men and establish dose-response relationships to guide prevention strategies.

pmc-12859481.title: Real-time 4D MRI reconstruction using DVR-NeMF, a framework for dynamic volumetric reconstruction
pmc-12859481.creator: Ruoxi Wang, Sijie Zhong, Jincheng Li, Weifeng Zhang, Shunwen Zheng, Ziyong Hao, Shuyu Liu, Xin Fang, Rushi Jiao, Yizhe Yuan, Bingsen Xue, Ning Ding, Yanfeng Wang, Ya Zhang, Hongjiang Wei, Zhiyong Zhang, Cheng Jin
pmc-12859481.description: SummaryIn this study, four dynamic magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) sequences were first developed to collect data. On this basis, we presented DVR-NeMF, a neural magnetic field framework that enables real-time, high-dimensional (4D) MRI reconstruction from synchronized dynamic 2D image slices and physiological signals.

pmc-12988040.title: Microplastics exposures in cataract surgery and potential clinical concerns
pmc-12988040.creator: Yun-Hee Choi, Myung-Sun Song, Nayoon Park, Seul-Ah Park, Jaehak Jung, Yoon-Hyeong Choi, Dong Hyun Kim
pmc-12988040.description: Microplastic (MP) exposures have been a significant global public health concern. Cataract surgery is the most frequently performed ocular surgery worldwide, and various plastic tools are used in cataract surgery. This study aimed to evaluate the characteristics of MPs in surgical devices, intraocular fluids, and cataractous crystalline lenses in cataract surgery.

pmc-13076560.title: Remimazolam versus propofol for postoperative ICU sedation in mechanically ventilated cancer patients: a noninferiority randomized clinical trial
pmc-13076560.creator: Congcong Zhao, Xiaoxuan Fan, Leying Li, Zihan Nan, Xin lin, Yaqi Han, Yanshuo Wu, Yanling Yin, Yan Xin, Zhenjie Hu
pmc-13076560.description: ObjectiveThis study aimed to compare the efficacy and safety of the novel ultra-short-acting benzodiazepine, remimazolam, versus propofol for short-term sedation in postoperative cancer patients during mechanical ventilation in the ICU.MethodsThis single-center, randomized noninferiority clinical trial was conducted from February 1st to 31 August 2024.

pmc-13428844.title: Prevalence and factors associated with hepatitis B vaccine uptake among undergraduate medical students in Tanzania: A cross-sectional study
pmc-13428844.creator: David G Paulo, Paulo A Kaniki, Hamis K Ibrahim
pmc-13428844.description: BackgroundHepatitis B virus remains a major global public health concern, responsible for significant morbidity and mortality due to complications such as chronic hepatitis, cirrhosis, and hepatocellular carcinoma. Hepatitis B virus prevalence remains high in many developing countries, including Tanzania, where it is estimated to be 7.17%.

pmc-13473804.title: Iterative Development and Usability Evaluation of an Open-Source Rehabilitation Follow-Up Platform: User-Centered Development Study
pmc-13473804.creator: Noora Emilia Angelva, Franziska Gurschler, Michael Single, Valerie Frischknecht, Dominik Näf, Noel Kampus, Eva Cioffi, Thimo Marcin, Branislav Savic, Matthias Wilhelm, Anke Scheel-Sailer, Anna Lisa Martin-Niedecken, Urs Mosimann, Tobias Nef
pmc-13473804.description: BackgroundRehabilitation frequently extends beyond supervised clinical settings, creating a demand for scalable digital tools to support structured follow-up. We propose a novel open-source telerehabilitation platform.ObjectiveWe describe the iterative, user-centered development of an open-source rehabilitation follow-up platform and report findings from an initial formative usability evaluation with patients, health care professionals, and additional end users.
